_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); chemical and refining signals

pit_profile.why: Risk factor (FY2012 10-K): Our businesses’ results are impacted by seasonal effects and are highly cyclical.; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names cloud or offshore delivery), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

classification.quality_note: Risk factor (FY2012 10-K): Our businesses’ results are impacted by seasonal effects and are highly cyclical.; no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing': none names chemicals or refining, and no 10-K names cloud or offshore delivery), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here (the PEP obesity rule). cyclical (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 1.42x; +78% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.89; conservative 2yr -22%.

BEAR.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (worst year FY11-FY13, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +0.0%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 3.1-yr ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +25.1%/yr (FY11-FY13 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +25.1%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY13, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LYB (retrospective, 2014-02-14) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.42x (39.6% downside to Bear $51 / +27.9% upside to Bull $108) | Adj composite 1.75 vs market 3.64: gap -1.89 [OVERVALUED] | +79% above the EPP floor $47 (7x FY14E $6.76) | Conservative 2-yr case: -22.1% total (-11.1%/yr) | At 12.5x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $112 sits above the BULL case; O&P–Americas +15.6% and Intermediates & Derivatives +30.5% operating income in Q4 2013, forward revenues +0.4% (no FY14 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2013 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a chemicals and refining company on this date; none has dated evidence.
